    grid = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    colors = {v for row in grid for v in row if v not in (0, 1, 5, 6)}
    # The lone non-background color marks the stamp; background noise is binary.
    color = next(v for v in colors if any(v in row for row in grid))

    c0 = min(c for r, c in points)

    source = [row[:] for row in grid]

        for c in range(w-sw+1):
            if all(source[r+dr][c+dc] == 0 for dr, dc in shape):
                for dr, dc in shape:
                    grid[r+dr][c+dc] = color
    return grid
'''
